session.name: MPI-622 session 22 - Phase 3 failed its ear gate, Phase 3.5 restructured the library

goal.original: Get Fabio's ear on the Phase 3 auditions, then start Phase 4 - wire MpiVoicePicker into the voice-changer flow.
goal.summary: PHASE 3 FAILED ITS EAR GATE AND PHASE 3.5 ANSWERED IT - shipped and pushed as 9215b8d5 (86 files). The library no longer claims to be 56 distinct voices: it is 15 SECTIONS of variations, 56 clips, and all 60 character auditions are deleted. Four voices retired, the villains split into four sections of one. Zero bench jobs, zero GPU - the whole phase was deletion. Bundle 6.14 -> 4.90 MB. Phase 4 is next and nothing blocks it.

completed: THE EAR VERDICT, and it reopened a decision the last handoff had fenced off as settled. On headphones and on the RAW samples, not just the auditions: within every section the voices are one person talking slightly differently - "every single section of 5 samples is like the same person just talking slightly differently", against ElevenLabs where voice-to-voice difference is "ginormous". This is the OWNER revising his own earlier approval on new evidence, not an agent relitigating.

RETIRED FOUR, NO BACKFILL: cartoon_critter_2, cartoon_critter_5, elderly_male_3 (each indistinguishable from a sibling), villain_menacing_3 (does not read as a villain). 60 -> 56. Fabio, verbatim: "let's not try to keep it at 60 samples, otherwise we're never gonna leave this place. Qwen has those limited voices, and the rest is history." Chasing within-section distinctness is CLOSED.

THE VILLAINS SPLIT INTO FOUR SECTIONS OF ONE - villain_monster_1 (null/null), villain_male_1 (male/adult), villain_female_1 (female/adult), villain_young_1 (male/young). They were never variations: five separate DIRECTION briefs, which is why gender surfaced in this section and nowhere else. Gender/age come from those generation-time sidecars, NEVER from f0 - an f0 split was proposed and would have put villain_menacing_3 and _5 on the wrong side. villain_young's age is the one place Fabio's ear overrode the sidecar's "Adult".

ALL 60 CHARACTER AUDITIONS DELETED, field and all. They cannot work even in principle: VC takes its delivery from the SOURCE performance, and in the shipping flow that source is the user's own recording, which does not exist at audition time. Every one previewed a stand-in performer - and because phase3_auditions.py reused ONE TTS clip per register (line 177, "one VC source per register (5 runs, not 60)"), they collapsed to a single voice per register. The VC route now previews the RAW SAMPLE, which is literally the file handed to target_voice. Reverses brief.md section 3's "never play sample.opus", deliberately.

THE LIBRARY IS SECTIONS OF VARIATIONS: `section` + `variation` on every voice, `listSections()` on the loader, display names composed from section + variation and never from the file stem (retiring cartoon_critter_2 renumbers the survivors 1/2/3). A section of one is a VOICE and is never labelled "Variation 1".

FIXED A SHIPPED BUG THE RESTRUCTURE EXPOSED: the picker passed manifest-relative paths straight to `new Audio()`, so every audition resolved against the PAGE and 404'd. Proven live - bare path 404, assetUrl 200. Invisible because the component-gallery fixture leaves every audition null, so playback had never once run against a real manifest.
TEST FIXTURE RE-CASED to snake_case (the item deferred to Phase 4 - done here since the fixture had to change anyway), plus new coverage for listSections and assetUrl.

VERIFIED: 14/14 contract checks, npm test 741/741, eslint clean, and a live browser probe of the REAL component against the REAL manifest - 15 sections, 56 cards, both routes building the right URL. Two rendering bugs came from LOOKING at it rather than from any test: a sticky section header covering its own first card (every "Variation 1" rendered nameless) and a register badge reading "Cartoon / Critter" on a Child variation. Both fixed.
My isolated app instance killed by VERIFIED PID after tracing its ancestry to my own `npm run app:isolated`; Fabio's app on :3000 answered HTTP 200 afterwards.

VC has no TTS stage, so the user's own recording carries the delivery and the six-emotion set may be audition-only here. The picker already emits `emotion` in its select payload for character/both voices. Settle this with Fabio BEFORE wiring the emotion control through - do not infer it.

Both are Phase 4 decisions with the route in hand.

NARRATION'S BRITISH-ACCENT DRIFT IS OPEN AND ACCEPTED, not a Phase 4 blocker. Fabio: "the British accent narration is what it is." It affects only the 57 narration previews he already called acceptable. NOTE: he also reports VC itself sometimes produces a British accent and re-pressing Generate re-rolls it. I argued VC carries the user's own accent and cannot invent one; he reaffirmed from listening. HIS EAR WINS - do not re-argue it, confirm it during Phase 4 when there are real VC runs to hear.

key_decisions: FABIO'S REVIEW CONVENTION: he names ONLY what he dislikes. Silence means approved. Misreading this cost session 18 an entire gate. Never re-ask for a verdict he has already given by not giving one.

A MEASUREMENT IS NOT A PERCEPTUAL VERDICT - this card has now paid for it EIGHT times. Session 22 added one: an f0-based villain gender split looked obvious and was wrong on two of five, caught only by reading the DIRECTION sidecars. When his ear and a number disagree, the number is wrong until proven otherwise.

THE LIBRARY IS 15 SECTIONS, NOT 56 VOICES, and the product must say so. Fabio: "for users, we should say 'variation of the same voice' instead of 'different voice' because it's not really a different voice." The grouping key is the SECTION (tags[0] / the new `section` field) exactly as the review page presented it - NOT register. He corrected an R-based reading explicitly: "Forget about the R sections... It's by type of voice, not by R section." Registers still drive performance-clip selection; they are not a user-facing axis.

AN AUDITION MUST PREVIEW ITS OWN ROUTE. Anything shared across voices inside one belongs to none of them - that is the rule the per-register VC-source reuse broke. A character audition cannot preview VC at all, because VC's source is the user's own recording.

AN EMOTION CELL OFF BAND IS CORRECT - the pitch lift IS the emotion, and `register` names the performer's baseline. Only the NEUTRAL cell is expected on baseline. Do not 'repair' angry or cheerful because they measure out of band.

Gender and age are DECLARED - by CATEGORY_META, and for the villains by the generation-time DIRECTION sidecar in lib_v2. NEVER inferred from audio. `accent` is null on every voice without exception - check 3 enforces it.

BASH MANGLES WINDOWS CLI FLAGS: `taskkill /PID` became `C:/Program Files/Git/PID` and failed. Use PowerShell. And BASH EATS $VAR INSIDE A DOUBLE-QUOTED powershell -Command - single-quote the PowerShell string or every $var arrives empty and the parser dies.

HEREDOCS ARE BLOCKED by guard-shell, but the block is not total - a `<<'EOF'` slipped through and committed a placeholder message that had to be amended. Write the commit message to a file and use `git commit -F <path>`.

KILL YOUR OWN APP INSTANCE BY VERIFIED PID, never by name pattern: an agent instance and Fabio's live app share the byte-identical `electron.exe .` command line. Get the port's PID from netstat, walk its ancestry with Get-CimInstance Win32_Process to confirm it traces to your own `npm run app:isolated`, then Stop-Process. Confirm :3000 still answers 200 afterwards.

THE APP SHELL WOULD NOT ROUTE TO THE COMPONENT GALLERY from a probe browser - ?view=components left the page on `page-landing` and handleNavigation() did nothing visible. Do not burn time on it: mount the component directly on a throwaway HTML page at the repo root (express.static serves __dirname) and delete it after. That probe is also how the audition 404 was proven.

AUTOPLAY IS BLOCKED in a headless probe, so `.play()` never fetches and the network log stays empty. To prove which URL a component builds, monkey-patch `window.Audio` and capture the constructor argument.

ingest.py NEEDS G:/ComfyUi/python_embeded/python.exe - the box's default python has no librosa. It is re-runnable and idempotent, reuses opus when the source is unchanged, and carries narration references forward BY ID - so any voice rename must patch the manifest ids BEFORE re-running or the references are silently dropped.
ALWAYS take the GPU through gpu_lease.py, and stop asking permission per run - Fabio's standing position, 2026-08-26. Phase 4 should need no GPU at all.
